authority_statement: M1 completion records evidence only and grants no trading authority or later-stage lifecycle authority.

explicitly_deferred_atoms.limits: Verified disposition only. No executable provider, production credential integration, service identity, or credential lifecycle is implemented or claimed.

explicitly_deferred_atoms.source: M1-SCOPE-2026-09-11-02; Implementation Specification v1.0 section 9 Stage 3 and GATE-S03-01
explicitly_deferred_atoms.limits: VERIFIED records only the attributable M1 scope disposition. It does not claim that any exchange calendar, session, holiday, early-close, DST-session, freshness, quarantine or point-in-time integrity functionality is implemented or tested.

explicitly_deferred_atoms.requirement: Persist/revoke/revalidate executable authority against current external evidence.
explicitly_deferred_atoms.source: Implementation Specification v1.0 sections 4.1, 8, 9 and 11 M1.6
explicitly_deferred_atoms.limits: VERIFIED records only the explicit M1 scope disposition. It does not claim persistence, runtime revocation, current external-evidence acquisition/revalidation, risk/compliance approval, OMS authority or executable permission. Those later controls remain required at their canonical stages.

explicitly_deferred_atoms.requirement: Implement transactional outbox and restart-safe event history.
explicitly_deferred_atoms.limits: VERIFIED records only the explicit M1 deferral. It does not claim a transactional outbox/inbox, persistent EventId history, restart/failover durability, handler-version consumption recording, reconstruction, resumption or runtime database enforcement.

explicitly_deferred_atoms.requirement: Emit structured causal telemetry for running financial workflows.
explicitly_deferred_atoms.limits: VERIFIED records only the explicit M1 deferral. It does not claim structured causal telemetry for an executable financial workflow, persistent reconstruction lineage, trace-completeness SLO evidence, runtime transport, or any financial execution capability. IMP-030-M1-07 is independently verified for its separately approved two-source M1 scope.

explicitly_deferred_atoms.requirement: Authenticate evidence and implement lifecycle promotion authority.
explicitly_deferred_atoms.source: Implementation Specification v1.0 section 10.1 and accepted M1.8 scope in docs/M1.8-evidence.md
explicitly_deferred_atoms.limits: VERIFIED records only the explicit M1 deferral and enforced non-authority boundary. It does not authenticate evidence, approve a gate, promote a lifecycle stage, validate semantic closure, authorize Stage 2, or claim M1 completion.

evidence.provenance_model: Repository-contained, source-hash-bound traceability and owner dispositions; historical attachment locations are non-normative.

restrictions: M1 completion does not authorize Stage 2.
M1 completion does not authorize paper trading.
M1 completion does not authorize live trading.
M1 completion does not authorize broker execution.
M1 completion does not authorize lifecycle promotion beyond completed M1.
